This page answers one question: **can we actually see the thing people are arguing about?**

If we cannot see it, we say so. We do not fill the hole with a story.

[This week's plain-language brief](articles/weekly-brief-2026-w35.qmd) · [Claim register (controls what we are allowed to assert)](articles/book-one-coupling-register.qmd)

## Right now

**Rain.** We have 30 years of monthly rain at nine places (Ubay, Manaus, Lagos, Nairobi, Jakarta, Mumbai, Mexico City, São Paulo, Paris). That is a sample, not the planet. The newest CHIRPS month on the public server was **July 2026**. August is late, not “no rain.”

**Heat.** Same nine places have a 30-year temperature series from ERA5. Useful for “is this July odd for *this* place?” Useless as a world average.

**Earthquakes.** We counted global quakes magnitude 4.5 and up, month by month, 1991–2020, split tropics vs the rest. That is a background rate, not this week's shaking at your house.

**Fire.** A satellite pass on 30 August 2026 saw about **5,000** hotspots worldwide. One whole western-southern box came back **empty while another box had thousands.** Empty here means the pull failed that region, not that nothing is burning.

**Pacific heat index (ONI).** The latest published seasonal number (May–July 2026) is **+1.39**. That is a Pacific measurement. It is not proof that your rainy season has already changed.

**Atlantic overturning (AMOC).** We do not have a fresh number on this board. Older public notes already called that series stale. Do not read rain in Ubay as “the AMOC.”

**Volcanic winter / collapsing food web / “move south.”** Not on this page. Those claims are parked or not supported by these gauges.

## How to use this

1. Look up **your** weather and fire service (PAGASA, BMKG, SMN, INMET, NOAA, …). This board does not replace them.
2. Compare a month to **the same month** in the 30-year record, not to Paris and not to “the tropics.”
3. If a box is empty or a month is late, treat it as **missing**, not calm.

This is advice. You can ignore it. No one is ordered to move, build, or stop a treatment because of this page.
